# Contributors

The list of contributors now lives in the [`contributors/`](contributors/)
folder: one small file per person, named after their GitHub username.

**Adding yourself?** Do not edit this file. Add your own file to
`contributors/` instead. [`contributors/README.md`](contributors/README.md)
shows how, and the community guide
[Your first pull request](https://community.codetopia.org/howtos/contributing/your-first-pull-request)
walks you through it in your browser.
